Sovereign commerce stacks—like the Edge Commerce Stack—provide a permanent alternative. They use decentralized payment networks, free hosting, and automated delivery systems to ensure you own your store, your data, and your revenue stream. This isn’t a patch; it’s a redesign of the base layer. Here’s how it compares to conventional platforms and why it’s the only choice for creators in restricted markets.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Conventional platforms like Gumroad promise simplicity but deliver dependency. They host your products, process payments, and manage delivery—until they don’t. When Stripe or PayPal restricts your country, your business stops. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, gives you ownership of every component. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free), uses Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, stores orders in Supabase, and delivers files via Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed on-chain through NOWPayments, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. No platform locks you in. No subscriptions. No sudden shutdowns. You own the code, the data, and the revenue stream. This isn’t a platform—it’s your infrastructure.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on geopolitical risk, regulatory hurdles, or currency instability. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle depend on these payment processors, so their restrictions become yours. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this entirely. It doesn’t rely on any single payment network or hosting provider. Cryptocurrency payments are borderless by design. NOWPayments verifies transactions on-chain, automatically triggering product delivery the moment payment confirms. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. This system doesn’t care about your country’s banking system or currency. It operates on a global, decentralized network. If you can access the internet, you can sell. If your buyers can send crypto, they can buy. No gatekeepers. No exceptions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal process payments in days, hold funds for review, and charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction—when they’re available. Crypto payments through NOWPayments confirm in minutes, with a flat 0.5% fee and no holding periods. The Edge Commerce Stack automates this process: payment hits the blockchain, webhook fires, product delivers instantly. No manual intervention. No buyer accounts required. The real cost of conventional platforms isn’t just fees—it’s lost sales from excluded markets. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates both. You pay a one-time $197 for deployment, own everything afterward, and keep 99.5% of every sale. Compare that to Gumroad’s 8.5% + $0.30 per transaction, plus the cost of being locked out entirely. The math is clear.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure removes platform dependency permanently.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Gumroad, your store lives on their servers. They control your data, your pricing, and your product delivery. If they shut down or change terms, you’re stranded. Sovereign commerce infrastructure inverts this. Your store runs on your GitHub or Cloudflare account. Orders are stored in your Supabase database. Files are delivered from your Cloudflare R2 bucket. Automation is built into the stack: payment triggers delivery, no manual steps. COREMERCH deploys this for you, loads your first five products, and hands over the keys. After that, it’s yours. No platform access. No recurring fees. Full ownership means full control. If a component fails, you replace it. If a payment network changes, you switch. Your business isn’t tied to anyone’s roadmap but your own.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a restricted market and need to sell digital products now, conventional platforms are not an option. They’re designed for a world that excludes you. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only alternative. The Edge Commerce Stack is built for creators who cannot afford to wait for Stripe or PayPal to enter their country. It’s for those who want to own their store, not rent it. If you’re selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software and need automatic delivery, crypto payments, and full data ownership, this is your architecture. It’s not a workaround—it’s a permanent solution. Deploy once, own forever. No platform risk. No geographic restrictions. Just commerce, on your terms.

Sovereign commerce infrastructure wins because it removes platform dependency entirely. Unlike Gumroad or Stripe, it doesn’t rely on excluded payment networks or hosting providers. Cryptocurrency payments are borderless, and the stack’s components—GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase—are globally accessible. You own the code, the data, and the revenue stream. No subscriptions. No shutdowns. It’s built for creators in restricted markets who need a permanent, self-owned solution.
Crypto payments confirm in minutes, with fees under $0.10 per transaction.

Ready to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack? The Edge Commerce Stack gives you everything you need: Cloudflare Pages hosting, automated backend logic, Supabase order storage, and instant crypto payment verification. Deployed in 48 hours, with your first five products loaded and end-to-end tested. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free). 2. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free). 3. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets (free). 4. Upload products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification (0.5% fee). 6. Test end-to-end: payment to delivery. 7. Deploy and own your stack. No platform access required.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed for you, with your products loaded and tested. You own the code but don’t need to write it. COREMERCH handles the setup, and you get lifetime access with no ongoing fees.
What if crypto prices fluctuate?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Buyers can pay in stablecoins like USDT or USDC to avoid volatility. You receive payment in your chosen currency, instantly convertible.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually by sending crypto back to the buyer’s wallet. The system doesn’t automate refunds, but the process is straightforward and doesn’t require a platform’s approval.
What happens if a component fails?
Since you own the infrastructure, you replace the failing component. For example, if Supabase has an outage, switch to Google Sheets. The stack is modular and doesn’t depend on any single provider.
Is this legal in my country?

The stack uses globally available tools and decentralized payments. As long as you can access the internet and use cryptocurrency, it works. Check local regulations regarding crypto use, but the infrastructure itself is compliant by design.
